name: reporting-agent
description: Reporting agent module for the CXL AI Native Marketer cohort: weekly reviews (executive, marketing sources, products, website traffic, and optionally email) built in n8n by Claude through the n8n MCP, delivered by Slack or Microsoft Teams, email, or a GitHub pull request, and read in your personal OS. /reporting-agent:build-reporting-demo builds Nick Christensen's v2 demo on made-up data; /reporting-agent:build-reporting-agent turns a copy of it into your own, on your GA4, store or CRM and email platform, one reconciled review at a time; /reporting-agent:build-reporting-agent-ads builds Nick's ads review as its own workflow; /reporting-agent:get-email-reports saves each run into your OS and reads it with you; /reporting-agent:how-to-build-yourself explains every node. Every build command first checks your folder and your n8n connection. Test build for review.
